questions.question: Line k is defined by 3x + 13y − 4 = 0. Line j is perpendicular to line k in the xy−plane. What is the slope of line j?
questions.explanation: Line k has slope −3/13, so a perpendicular line has slope 13/3.

questions.question:
Line r is defined by the equation 4x − 3y = 8. Line s is parallel to line r in the xy-plane.
What is the slope of line s?
questions.explanation: Solve for y: y = (4/3)x − 8/3. Parallel lines have equal slopes, so the slope is 4/3.

A certain goose species can fly at an average speed of 16 meters per second when in continuous flight. At this rate, how many meters would this goose species fly in 6 seconds?

questions.question: At a convention center, there are a total of 375 visitors. Each visitor is located in either room A, room B, or room C. If one of these visitors is selected at random, the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in room A is 0.48, and the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in room B is 0.24. How many visitors are located in room C?

A computer program models the population of a certain insect in an environment where the insect has no natural predators. According to the model, the estimated total mass of the population of insects at the end of every 5-week period is 158% greater than the estimated total mass of the population of insects at the end of the previous 5-week period. The estimated total mass of the population of insects at the end of 15 weeks is 627.7 grams. Which equation best represents this model, where M is the estimated total mass, in grams, of the population of insects at the end of t weeks?
questions.explanation: The mass is multiplied by 1 + 1.58 = 2.58 every 5 weeks, so M = a(2.58)^(t/5). At t = 15, a(2.58)^3 = 627.7, so a ≈ 36.55.

The volume of a right rectangular prism with a square base is 2,448 cubic centimeters. If the area of the square base is 144 square centimeters, what is the area, in square centimeters, of one of the four lateral faces of the prism?
questions.explanation: The base side is 12 and the height is 2448/144 = 17, so a lateral face has area 12 × 17 = 204.

questions.question: In the figure, AC = CD. The measure of angle EBC is 29°, and the measure of angle ACD is 108°. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: In triangle ACD, the base angles are (180 − 108)/2 = 36°. In triangle BDE, the angle at D is 36° and the angle at B is 29°, so the exterior angle x = 36 + 29 = 65.

questions.question: A certain investment account offers a special interest rate for the first 6 months the account is open followed by a lower interest rate for the remainder of the time the account is open. Every 2 months after the first 8 months, the balance had increased by an additional 0.3% of the balance 2 months before. Which of the following equations could represent the account balance B(x), in dollars, x months after the account was opened, where x ≥ 6?

A certain investment account offers a special interest rate for the first 4 months the account is open followed by a lower interest rate for the remainder of the time the account is open. Bennett opened one of these accounts with an original account balance of $900 and did not make any other deposits or withdrawals. 4 months after Bennett opened the account, the balance had increased by 0.6% of the original balance. 6 months after Bennett opened the account, the balance had increased by an additional 0.3% of the balance at the end of the first 4 months. Every 2 months after the first 6 months, the balance had increased by an additional 0.3% of the balance 2 months before. Which of the following equations could represent the account balance B(x), in dollars, x months after the account was opened, where x ≥ 4?
questions.explanation: After 4 months the balance is 900(1.006) = 905.40. After that it grows by a factor of 1.003 every 2 months, which is (x − 4)/2 periods, so the exponent is x/2 − 4/2.

questions.question:
Orbital period (days)

A data set of the orbital periods, rounded to the nearest whole number of Earth days, for 13 of Jupiter’s moons is represented in the dot plot. An additional moon with an orbital period of 251 days is added to the original data set to create a new data set of 14 orbital periods. Which statement best compares the mean and median of the new data set to the mean and median of the original data set?
options: The mean of the new data set is equal to the mean of the original data set, and the median of the new data set is equal to the median of the original data set.
The mean of the new data set is equal to the mean of the original data set, and the median of the new data set is less than the median of the original data set.
The mean of the new data set is less than the mean of the original data set, and the median of the new data set is less than the median of the original data set.
The mean of the new data set is less than the mean of the original data set, and the median of the new data set is equal to the median of the original data set.
questions.explanation: Original sorted values (720,720,723,723,723,724,724,726,727,728,730,730,732) have median 724. Adding 251 lowers the mean; the new median is the average of the 7th and 8th values, both 724, so it is unchanged.

questions.question: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at (19, 16) and has a radius of 8k. Which equation represents this circle?
questions.explanation: The right side is the radius squared: (8k)^2 = 64k^2.

questions.question: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, where angle A corresponds to angle D and angle C corresponds to angle F. Angles C and F are right angles. If tan A = 61235, what is the value of sin D?
questions.explanation: Take legs 612 and 35 in triangle ABC; the hypotenuse is √(612^2 + 35^2) = 613. Similar triangles have equal angle measures, so sin D = sin A = 612/613.
